question: Supplier S-104 will miss its next ship date. Handle it.
answer:
I've moved Lacrivia stock to the East DC, put its two wholesalers on an approved allocation, and handed the supplier, plant and wholesaler-notice work to the right teams. I couldn't raise a backup order because no other supplier is approved for the affected material.

**What's at risk**
- **Missed shipment:** S-104 (Delmar) will miss PO005791: 4,200 units of RM-221 (Polysorbate 80), due to ship 2026-10-07. S-104 is the only approved source; S-131 (Pinecrest) isn't approved to ship it to any plant.
- **Products affected:**
  - Plant PL-01: Lacrivia 5 mL and 10 mL, and Cyclosporine OS 0.05% (FG-1001, FG-1002, FG-1003).
  - Plant PL-03: 11 lens-care products (FG-3001 to FG-3011). None are stocked at the distribution centers.
- **Where it hurts now:** DC-EAST has had no Lacrivia restock since about 2026-08-21, while demand stayed steady. It has 46 units of the 5 mL (safety stock 471, about 237 sold a week) and 34 of the 10 mL (safety stock 233, about 110 a week). That's under a week of supply. The Central and West DCs are above safety stock.

**What I did**
1. **Approved stock transfers to DC-EAST.** The Supply Planning lead approved all four. Each DC ends up with the same weeks of supply (about 2.5 for 5 mL, 2.8 for 10 mL, based on the last 13 weeks of shipments), and Central and West stay above safety stock.
   - 5 mL: 277 units from DC-CENTRAL (APR-870E257F) and 279 from DC-WEST (APR-9FC4C993).
   - 10 mL: 141 units from DC-CENTRAL (APR-8DE0FC11) and 139 from DC-WEST (APR-61F5B302).
2. **Approved allocation at DC-EAST** (APR-501E0E50), split in proportion to each wholesaler's DC-EAST shipments over the last 13 weeks. Recorded in the ERP as:

| | W-01 Keystone | W-02 Atlas | Allocation records |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 mL (602 units) | 274 | 328 | AL-33E89C63, AL-722B1452, AL-D771D670 |
| 10 mL (314 units) | 174 | 140 | AL-AFEA7748, AL-F2B20BB4, AL-9135F7B7 |

3. **Cases opened:**
   - **CASE-DB319B8C (Procurement / Supplier Quality):** get a firm recovery date from S-104 and push for a partial or faster shipment. Also check whether their later orders are at risk (PO000369 for RM-221, PO000430 for RM-222). Start urgent approval of a second RM-221 supplier, and confirm PO005791 is valid (see the last point below).
   - **CASE-5DED3215 (Production Planning, PL-01 and PL-03):** confirm how much RM-221 the plants hold, reschedule production to protect Lacrivia, and find out why DC-EAST stopped being restocked.
   - **CASE-5F5451C8 (Trade Relations / Customer Service):** send the allocation notices to W-01 and W-02.

**What I didn't do, and why**
- **No backup order:** I didn't raise a purchase requisition with S-131 because it isn't approved for RM-221, and a second order with S-104 wouldn't help.
- **Wholesaler notices not sent by me:** the EDI gateway can't send outbound messages (HTTP 501), so Trade Relations has them (CASE-5F5451C8).
- **Wholesaler stock unknown:** their inventory feed was unavailable (HTTP 503), so I couldn't see how much Lacrivia they already hold.
- **No rebalancing for Cyclosporine OS (FG-1003):** every DC is well above safety stock.
- **No rebalancing for lens care:** those products aren't stocked at the distribution centers; the plant case covers them.
- **No customer prescription, claims or sales-incentive data was used** for the allocation; it rests on shipment history only.

**Assumptions**
- "Next ship date" means the earliest open S-104 order, PO005791. Its order number is out of S-104's normal sequence and its lead time is unusually long, so I've asked Procurement to confirm it's valid.
- The approval requests show $0 because neither system has a unit cost or list price. The approver was told this and asked to value the transfers.
- The lead approved everything with no notes, and the transfers draw Central and West down toward safety stock (Central 5 mL keeps 400 against 314). Those DCs will also feel the shortage if the delay runs long.

SELECT * FROM dbo.PURCH_ORD_ARCHIVE WHERE SUPPLIER_ID='S-104' AND PROMISED_SHIP_DT>='2026-09-01' ORDER BY PROMISED_SHIP_DT

SELECT b.*, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.MATERIAL_TYP FROM dbo.BOM b LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m ON m.MATERIAL_ID=b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID WHERE b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID IN ('RM-221','RM-222')

WITH x AS (
 SELECT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID AS MAT, CAST(b.QTY_PER AS decimal(18,6)) AS QTY, 1 AS LVL, CAST(b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID + '>' + b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID AS varchar(400)) AS PATH
 FROM dbo.BOM b WHERE b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b.EFF_FROM AND b.EFF_TO
 UNION ALL
 SELECT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID, CAST(x.QTY*b.QTY_PER AS decimal(18,6)), x.LVL+1, CAST(x.PATH + '>' + b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID AS varchar(400))
 FROM x JOIN dbo.BOM b ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=x.MAT AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b.EFF_FROM AND b.EFF_TO
 WHERE x.LVL<8)
SELECT x.MAT, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.MATERIAL_TYP, m.PACK_SZ, x.QTY, x.LVL, x.PATH FROM x LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m ON m.MATERIAL_ID=x.MAT ORDER BY x.LVL, x.MAT

SELECT b1.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID L0, b1.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID L1, b2.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID L2, b3.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID L3, b4.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID L4, b1.QTY_PER q1, b2.QTY_PER q2, b3.QTY_PER q3, b4.QTY_PER q4
FROM dbo.BOM b1
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b2 ON b2.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=b1.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b2.EFF_FROM AND b2.EFF_TO
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b3 ON b3.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=b2.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b3.EFF_FROM AND b3.EFF_TO
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b4 ON b4.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=b3.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b4.EFF_FROM AND b4.EFF_TO
WHERE b1.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b1.EFF_FROM AND b1.EFF_TO

WITH l1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM WHERE CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l1 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l1.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l2 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l2.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l3 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l3.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l5 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l4 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l4.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l6 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l5 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l5.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l7 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l6 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l6.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l8 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l7 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l7.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l9 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l8 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l8.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l10 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l9 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l9.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
allm AS (SELECT 1 lvl,m FROM l1 UNION ALL SELECT 2,m FROM l2 UNION ALL SELECT 3,m FROM l3 UNION ALL SELECT 4,m FROM l4 UNION ALL SELECT 5,m FROM l5 UNION ALL SELECT 6,m FROM l6 UNION ALL SELECT 7,m FROM l7 UNION ALL SELECT 8,m FROM l8 UNION ALL SELECT 9,m FROM l9 UNION ALL SELECT 10,m FROM l10)
SELECT lvl, mt.MATERIAL_TYP, COUNT(*) n, MIN(a.m) mn, MAX(a.m) mx FROM allm a LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL mt ON mt.MATERIAL_ID=a.m GROUP BY lvl, mt.MATERIAL_TYP ORDER BY lvl

WITH l1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM WHERE CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l1 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l1.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l2 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l2.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l3 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l3.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l5 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l4 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l4.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l6 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l5 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l5.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
l7 AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID m FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN l6 ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=l6.m WHERE '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO),
fg AS (SELECT m FROM l5 UNION SELECT m FROM l7)
SELECT mt.MATERIAL_ID, mt.MATERIAL_DESC, mt.MATERIAL_TYP, mt.PACK_SZ, x.* FROM fg JOIN dbo.MATERIAL mt ON mt.MATERIAL_ID=fg.m LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL_NDC_XREF x ON x.MATERIAL_ID=fg.m WHERE mt.MATERIAL_TYP='FG' ORDER BY 1

SELECT i.DC_ID, i.MATERIAL_ID, i.SNAPSHOT_DT, i.ON_HAND_UNITS, i.SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV i JOIN (SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) d FROM dbo.DC_INV GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID) l ON l.DC_ID=i.DC_ID AND l.MATERIAL_ID=i.MATERIAL_ID AND l.d=i.SNAPSHOT_DT WHERE i.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003') OR i.MATERIAL_ID LIKE 'FG-30%' ORDER BY i.MATERIAL_ID, i.DC_ID

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID, COUNT(*) n, SUM(UNITS) units, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(SHIP_DT) mx FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003') AND SHIP_DT > DATEADD(week,-13,'2026-09-30') GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, WHSLR_ID

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT>='2026-07-01' ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT

SELECT * FROM dbo.PLANT_MATERIAL WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('CMP-310','SEMI-031','SEMI-044','SEMI-045','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','FILL-1003','FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','INT-LC1011','INT-LC1035','CMP-320') ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID
SELECT * FROM dbo.SUPPLIER WHERE SUPPLIER_ID IN ('S-104','S-130','S-131')

SELECT DATEADD(week, DATEDIFF(week,'2026-01-04',SHIP_DT),'2026-01-04') wk, MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN WHSLR_ID IN ('W-01','W-03','W-05') THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) w_odd, SUM(CASE WHEN WHSLR_ID IN ('W-02','W-04','W-06') THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) w_even FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SHIP_DT>='2026-06-28' GROUP BY DATEADD(week, DATEDIFF(week,'2026-01-04',SHIP_DT),'2026-01-04'), MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, wk

escalation_cases.subject: S-104 Delmar will miss the RM-221 ship date on PO005791 – expedite, and no qualified second source
escalation_cases.details: S-104 (Delmar Specialty Chemicals, IN) will miss the next ship date: PO005791, RM-221 Polysorbate 80 NF low-peroxide, 4,200 units, promised to ship 2026-10-07. The next RM-221 PO after that is PO000369 (3,300 units, promised 2026-10-29). There is also an open RM-222 PO, PO000430 (promised 2026-10-26). S-104 is the only qualified source for RM-221 and is approved to ship it to PL-01 and PL-03. The alternate, S-131 Pinecrest (CN), is NOT qualified or approved for RM-221, so I did not raise a purchase requisition with it. Requests: (1) Get a firm recovery ship date and quantity from S-104, push for a partial or expedited shipment, and confirm whether PO000369 and the RM-222 PO000430 are also at risk. (2) Start urgent qualification of a second RM-221 source (S-131 or another). (3) Note a data anomaly: PO005791 is numbered outside S-104's normal PO sequence (PO0003xx) and has an unusually long lead time (ordered 2026-09-02, ship 2026-10-07), so please confirm it is valid. Impact: RM-221 feeds CMP-310, the emulsifier premix used for Lacrivia 5 mL and 10 mL and for Cyclosporine OS 0.05% (FG-1001/1002/1003, PL-01). It also feeds lens-care intermediates INT-LC1011 and INT-LC1035 (PL-03, FG-3001 to FG-3011). DC-EAST Lacrivia was already below safety stock, and approved transfers and an allocation are now in place.

escalation_cases.subject: RM-221 supply miss – check PL-01 and PL-03 schedules, and why DC-EAST Lacrivia replenishment stopped
escalation_cases.details: S-104 will miss the RM-221 (Polysorbate 80) ship date on PO005791 (4,200 units, due 2026-10-07). Our systems have no plant raw-material inventory table, so please confirm RM-221 on hand and the days of production it covers at PL-01 and PL-03. Products affected under BOMs effective 2026-09-30: (a) PL-01: CMP-310 to SEMI-031, SEMI-044/045, FILL-1001/1002/1003, then FG-1001 Lacrivia 5 mL, FG-1002 Lacrivia 10 mL and FG-1003 Cyclosporine 0.05% 5 mL. (b) PL-03: INT-LC1011 and INT-LC1035, which run through the lens-care chain to FG-3001 to FG-3011. Please re-sequence production to protect Lacrivia, the highest-demand product. Also: DC-EAST stopped receiving Lacrivia replenishment around 2026-08-21. FG-1001 fell from 1,227 to 46 units and FG-1002 from 572 to 34, while DC-CENTRAL and DC-WEST kept being replenished. Please find out why. Interim actions approved: transfers of 556 units of FG-1001 and 280 units of FG-1002 from DC-CENTRAL and DC-WEST to DC-EAST, plus a DC-EAST allocation (APR-501E0E50).

We will tell you when normal supply resumes." Allocation records: AL-33E89C63, AL-722B1452, AL-D771D670 (5 mL); AL-AFEA7748, AL-F2B20BB4, AL-9135F7B7 (10 mL).
